clue.text: Forestry Commission

parts.note: reads as the UK body that runs state forests, but cryptically asks what forestry is commissioned to produce: felled wood

explanation.surface: A bare name: the British government agency in charge of forests.
explanation.walkthrough: The Forestry Commission is the UK government department managing public woodland; here 'Commission' is taken as the job forestry is set, which is growing wood for building.
explanation.definitionFit: Wood grown and felled for building is the product a forestry business is commissioned to supply.

clue.text: Embedded in the front line and in distress

parts.note: the second in

indicators.note: the front of a word is its opening letter, so only the start of line is used

parts.note: someone in distress calls for aid, so the phrase stands for help

explanation.surface: A war reporter embedded with troops at the front, caught up in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Embedded' and 'front line' suggest a war correspondent; it is the definition, as in a design set into wood.
explanation.definitionFit: A decoration that is inlaid has been set into the surface, so it is embedded in it.

clue.text: One (and more) sportsmen led around inside

indicators.note: the scrambled word is placed within the sportsmen's word

parts.note: boxers are sportsmen who fight in the ring

indicators.note: the letters of led are moved around into a new order

explanation.surface: Sportsmen jostling round a leader in the middle of a group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' throughout this puzzle points to 1 Across, TIMBER, so each 'One' clue defines a kind of tree; 'and more' makes this one plural.
explanation.definitionFit: The box elder is a North American maple, a timber tree, and the plural covers more than one.

clue.text: Artist and a winter sculpture that gets down to earth!

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a recognised artist

indicators.note: a sculpture reshapes its material, so the letters of a winter are reshaped

explanation.surface: An artist and a snow sculpture made one winter that is very grounded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sculpture' works on A WINTER to give AINWATER after RA. 'down to earth' is taken literally: falling from sky to ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Precipitation falling from clouds is water that literally comes down to the ground.

clue.text: More than ready to give help on the line?

definitions.meaning: the comparative of prompt, meaning readier or quicker

definitions.text: to give help on the line?
definitions.meaning: in a theatre, the person offstage feeds actors a forgotten line

explanation.surface: Someone extra keen to assist a caller on the telephone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the line' suggests a phone call, but the line is an actor's line in a play.
explanation.definitionFit: Prompt means ready or quick, so its comparative is readier; a theatre assistant who feeds forgotten lines has the same title.

clue.text: Competent finally to settle what's due

indicators.note: the competent word comes at the end, after the settling word

parts.note: to settle a bill is to pay it
competent means able

explanation.surface: Being capable at last of clearing what you owe.
explanation.definitionFit: An amount that is owed and must be paid is described as due or outstanding.

clue.text: One is from the Mediterranean girl

definitions.meaning: One points to 1 Across, TIMBER: a tree typical of the Mediterranean region

explanation.surface: A young woman who comes from Mediterranean lands.
explanation.definitionFit: The olive tree grows across southern Europe, and Olive is also a traditional female first name.

clue.text: One that's made from part of party manifesto

definitions.meaning: One points to 1 Across, TIMBER: a board sawn from it
a single policy within a political platform

explanation.surface: A clause written into a political party's election programme.
explanation.walkthrough: A political platform is built of policy 'planks', the same word as a sawn board.
explanation.definitionFit: A long flat board is sawn from timber, and a single policy in a platform is figuratively called by the same name.

clue.text: Rising to join forces in hospital department

indicators.note: the joining word sits inside the hospital department

parts.note: ENT is the ear, nose and throat department
to merge is to join together

explanation.surface: Departments uniting forces within a hospital as part of a reorganisation.
explanation.definitionFit: Something emerging is coming up into view, so it is rising or appearing.

clue.text: Strike with 40 in Yankee plant

indicators.note: the number goes inside the striking word

parts.note: to flail is to strike out wildly
XL is forty in Roman numerals
Y is Yankee in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Lashing out alongside forty in an American plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' just links the strike to its contents; 'Yankee' is the radio-alphabet word for Y.
explanation.definitionFit: The New Zealand flax lily is a leafy perennial grown in gardens, a kind of plant.

clue.text: Impatient? Not Tim — incredibly, he's sulking!

indicators.note: incredibly suggests the remaining letters are wildly rearranged once the name is gone

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An impatient person, not Tim this time, is in a strop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not Tim' removes T, I and M from IMPATIENT, leaving PAIENT; 'incredibly' rearranges that.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in a pet is an old British idiom for being in a sulk or a huff.

clue.text: One expresses wonder at the evil within

indicators.note: the evil word is put inside the exclamation

parts.note: wow is an exclamation of amazement
ill means harm or evil

explanation.surface: Someone gasping in amazement at the wickedness inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' refers to 1 Across, TIMBER: the clue defines a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The willow is a tree whose wood is used for cricket bats and baskets, so it is a timber.

clue.text: Said "stop" on time but a fracture resulted

indicators.note: said signals that the stopping word is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a brake is a device that stops a vehicle
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone called for a halt in good time, yet something still got broken.
explanation.definitionFit: A breakage is a break or split, the same as a fracture.

clue.text: One is a bit old-fashioned

indicators.note: a bit of the word old-fashioned supplies the letters

explanation.surface: Someone who is slightly behind the times.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' refers to 1 Across, TIMBER: the clue defines a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The ash is a hardwood tree valued for tool handles, so it is a timber.

clue.text: Men in centre then lost energy, requiring treatment and defensive work

indicators.note: words needing treatment are worked over into a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

indicators.note: the energy symbol is lost from the word then

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Soldiers in the middle ran out of steam and needed medical attention.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lost energy' drops E from THEN to leave THN; 'requiring treatment' rearranges MEN, CENTRE and THN together.
explanation.definitionFit: A trench line or earthwork built for protection is a defensive work, or fortification.

clue.text: One hiding a crooked pile in deep gorge

indicators.note: the bent letters sit inside the gorge word

parts.note: a chine is a deep narrow ravine, as on the Isle of Wight coast

indicators.note: crooked means bent out of shape, so the letters of pile are twisted

explanation.surface: A tree hiding a lopsided heap down in a ravine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' refers to 1 Across, TIMBER. A chine is a southern English word for a steep coastal ravine.
explanation.definitionFit: The Chile pine, or monkey puzzle, is a South American conifer, a tree yielding timber.

clue.text: Chap to send away for vegetables

parts.note: a chap is a man
to get someone out is to send them away

explanation.surface: A man told to dismiss someone in exchange for some greens.
explanation.definitionFit: Mangetout are flat pea pods eaten whole, a kind of green vegetable.

clue.text: One stood up to seek support for director

parts.note: rose means got to one's feet
to woo is to court or seek the backing of

explanation.surface: Someone got up to canvass backing for a film director.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' refers to 1 Across, TIMBER: the clue defines a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Rosewood is a dark tropical hardwood prized for furniture and instruments, a fine timber.

clue.text: Design college renovations to promote good husbandry

indicators.note: design means arrange afresh, so the letters are laid out in a new pattern

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Plans for college building work to encourage sound farming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Design' looks like a noun leading the sentence, but it is the instruction to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Careful management that protects land and resources is good husbandry, or stewardship of the environment.

clue.text: One on the Spanish motorway

parts.note: el is the Spanish masculine article
M is used for British motorways such as the M1

explanation.surface: A traveller on the road in Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' refers to 1 Across, TIMBER: the clue defines a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The elm is a large deciduous tree whose wood was used for coffins and boats, so it is a timber.

clue.text: Tests everything about the first lady of Sweden

indicators.note: the everything word goes around the first lady

parts.note: all means everything
Eve was the first woman in Genesis
S is the international vehicle code for Sweden

explanation.surface: Total checks on the wife of the Swedish leader.
explanation.walkthrough: A levels are the British school-leaving examinations taken at about 18.
explanation.definitionFit: A levels are the advanced examinations taken in English schools, so they are tests.

clue.text: One manufactures pie crust without it

indicators.note: to manufacture is to put together, so the remaining letters are assembled anew

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A baker makes pastry without using the usual ingredient.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without it' takes I and T from PIECRUST, leaving PECRUS; 'manufactures' rearranges that. 'One' refers to 1 Across, TIMBER.
explanation.definitionFit: The spruce is a conifer whose pale wood is used in building and instruments, a timber tree.

clue.text: Wife's dislike for prog rock band's music initially restrained

indicators.note: the band and the letter are held inside the dislike word

parts.note: hate is strong dislike
ELP is Emerson, Lake and Palmer, a 1970s progressive rock band

indicators.note: only the first letter of music is used

explanation.surface: A wife who hated her husband's prog rock collection kept quiet.
explanation.walkthrough: ELP were a British progressive rock trio of the 1970s.
explanation.definitionFit: A helpmate is a companion and helper, traditionally a wife or partner.

clue.text: Joanna is loud? On the contrary!

definitions.meaning: Cockney rhyming slang for the instrument with keys
the opposite of loud in musical notation, meaning softly

explanation.surface: A woman named Joanna is said to be noisy, or rather the reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: Joanna is Cockney rhyming slang for the keyboard instrument; the musical marking for soft is the opposite of forte.
explanation.definitionFit: The musical direction for soft is the opposite of loud, and the keyboard instrument shares the name via rhyming slang.

clue.text: One has lost more hair, except at the front

indicators.note: the opening letter is dropped from the word for losing more hair

parts.note: balder describes someone with less hair than another

explanation.surface: A man who has gone balder, apart from his fringe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' refers to 1 Across, TIMBER: the clue defines a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The alder is a waterside tree whose wood is used for smoking and guitars, so it is a timber.

clue.text: Free from old girlfriend's timeless invite!

parts.note: an ex is a former partner

indicators.note: the time symbol T is removed from the inviting word

parts.note: to tempt is to invite or entice

explanation.surface: Released from an awkward invitation by a former girlfriend.
explanation.definitionFit: Being exempt from something means being free of a duty or rule, excused.

clue.text: Senile person almost late for opening event

parts.note: a do is a party or event

indicators.note: almost means the last letter is left off

parts.note: tardy means late

explanation.surface: An old person turns up nearly late for the opening ceremony.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for opening' puts DO first, opening the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A dotard is an old person whose mind has weakened with age.

clue.text: Gourmet, having credit removed, has One introduced in conclusion

indicators.note: the One word is put inside what is left
the credit abbreviation is taken out of the gourmet word

parts.note: an epicure is a gourmet
CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit
One points to 1 Across, TIMBER, here a log

explanation.surface: A food lover, short of money, brings someone in at the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having credit removed' leaves EPIUE from EPICURE; One (1 Across, TIMBER) gives LOG.
explanation.definitionFit: An epilogue is a closing section at the end of a book or play, its conclusion.

clue.text: Puts off a day in Paris when Dan's messing around!

indicators.note: the scrambled name goes around the French word
messing about means jumbling, so the letters of the name are rearranged

parts.note: taken with its s
jour is French for day

explanation.surface: A man delays things whenever Dan fools about.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital-letter name looks like a person in the surface, but its letters, possessive s included, are the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: To adjourn a meeting is to postpone it, so adjourns means puts off.

clue.text: Linden trees shade a formal entrance

indicators.note: the trees shade, or conceal, the letters within them

explanation.surface: Lime trees cast shade over a grand doorway.
explanation.definitionFit: An entree is the right of admission or a formal entry into society.
